results.content:
CNN data analyst Harry Enten on Monday highlighted new polling data showing Trump’s approval slipping among Hispanic voters. He pointed to polling data from CNN and SSRS showing that the president’s approval rating among Hispanic men is -41 points despite winning them by 10 points less than two years ago.

“All of that movement that you saw, that historic performance that President Trump had among Hispanic men, adios amigos. Goodbye. See you later,” he said. [...] Meanwhile, a UnidosUS poll also found him underwater with Latino men, finding his approval at 34 percent and disapproval at 64 percent. results.title: Donald Trump’s Approval Rating Has Crashed With Hispanic Men

results.content:
In 2024, Trump won the Hispanic male vote by 10 percentage points. But now, he has a minus 41 point net approval rating among the group.

“By my math, a 51-point switcheroo against the President of the United States. All of that movement that you saw that historic performance that President Trump had amongst Hispanic men — Adios, amigos. Goodbye. See you later,” Enten said.

He said that the economy is hurting Trump among Hispanic male voters. [...] “It’s the economy. We’re seeing this across the board, but you’re specifically seeing it amongst Hispanic men,” he said.

results.content: Trump is also bleeding support among Black and Hispanic voters, and especially men, as Bloomberg Government reports.
